The Philosophy

The Experience
No. 1

Take a seat

Settle in — at the counter, or at the table. Everything that follows is made fresh to order.

No. 2

Order at your pace

Nigiri, rolls, yakitori and more — ordered as you go, never waiting on a buffet line.

No. 3

Savor

Stay for another round. Finish with something sweet — the soft serve is a guest favorite.
